scientific_queries.note: Leave-one-drug-out test on the locally held GDSC screen; no novelty claim.

subagent_note: None dispatched: the round's own R2 recomputation is the challenge that corrected the pre-registered baseline.

design.features: pathway one-hot for anchor (17) and library (21) plus tissue (3); drug identity never enters

baseline_error.what: H070's 'better than the constant' was implemented with Spearman, but a constant prediction has zero rank variance so the statistic is undefined; rho_const was NaN and frac_drugs_model_better was miscomputed as 0.00
baseline_error.fix: recomputed with R2 on the same folds; the model beats the constant by +0.056 [+0.030,+0.067] on 80% of drugs

decisions.H071_substantial_0.20: misses by 0.0004 (median 0.1996); reported as borderline rather than adjusted

headline: with no data at all about a held-out drug and only its pathway annotation, synergy can be ranked weakly (rho 0.20, AUC 0.68) but its magnitude cannot be predicted (R2 0.03): rankable, not quantifiable
scope: annotation-level generalisation: drugs sharing the same pathway remain visible in training, so this is not a fully uninformative new drug
